steps.editorState:
What can we use as a bubble wand?

Here are some ideas:

What to do:

  1. Measure the washing-up liquid into your container. 
  2. Slowly add the water, being careful not to make too many bubbles yet!
  3. Gently stir the mixture.
  4. Ideally, let the bubble mixture rest before you use it.

You will need:

  • 50ml washing-up liquid
  • 300ml water
  • A large bowl for mixing
  • Something to stir with - a chopstick or spoon will work well
  • Measuring jug or weighing scales

editorState:
How to play:

Just blow the bubbles and play!

Encourage your child to:

  • Get down low or reach up high: Wow! You jumped so high!
  • Grab the bubbles with their hand: I wonder if you can catch the bubbles?
  • Pop them with a finger: Point and POP! Point and POP! 

ALL of these big and small movements are strengthening your child’s muscles and helping their balance and coordination!
